subtitle: Out Manila · Qingdao Airlines
overview: Fly a Qingdao Airlines charter from Manila to Changsha, then travel on to Zhangjiajie for the “Avatar” scenery of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Tusi City and a 2-hour skiing experience at Qixing Mountain. Stays are in Days Hotel by Wyndham Changsha and Ramada Hotel Zhangjiajie or similar. Several shop stops are compulsory.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 31–Jan 4 2026 to Feb 11–15 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Changsha
items: Fly Manila to Changsha (QW966, 03:45–07:00) and meet your guide at the airport
Mini Venice Town in Changsha (entrance fee only)
Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Changsha – Zhangjiajie
items: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Avatar scenic area, up and down by Bailong Lift or Tianzishan cable car
Eternal Love Show or Charming Xiangxi Show (optional)

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Compulsory shopping stop: Chinese medicine shop
Tianmen Mountain with cable car, glass skywalk and Tianmen Cave (optional)
After dinner, transfer back to hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Qixing Mountain skiing
items: Qixing Mountain Scenic Area with battery car, 1520 Platform and glass skywalk
2-hour skiing experience including ski equipment (snow suit excluded); if the ski resort is closed due to weather, Qixing Mountain and skiing change to the indoor ski at Snow and Ice World
After dinner, transfer back to hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Changsha – Manila
items: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Grand Canyon scenic area – Glass Bridge (optional)
Transfer back to Changsha and fly to Manila (QW965, 23:30–02:45+1)

placeDesc.Orange Isle: A long river island in the Xiang River at Changsha, with parks and riverside views; battery car not included.
placeDesc.Mini Venice Town: A canal-style tourist town in Changsha, visited with entrance fee included.
placeDesc.Taiping Old Street: A historic street in old Changsha lined with traditional-style shops and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Huangxing Road Walking Street: Changsha's central pedestrian shopping street, busy with shops, snacks and street life.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar scenic area: Sandstone pillar peaks in Zhangjiajie that inspired the floating mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to reach the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Tianzishan Cable Car: A cable car that carries guests up to the Tianzi Mountain area with views over the sandstone peaks.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in the Zhangjiajie park, a scenic viewing stop in the Avatar area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The pillar mountain in Zhangjiajie that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in the film Avatar.
placeDesc.Tusi City: A site in Zhangjiajie built around the history and culture of the Tujia tusi chieftains.
placeDesc.Qixing Mountain: A mountain scenic area near Zhangjiajie visited by battery car, with a glass skywalk and the 1520 Platform.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform on Qixing Mountain included on the Day 4 sightseeing.
placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A mountain lake near Zhangjiajie, visited on an optional cruise.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie reached by cable car, with a glass skywalk and the Tianmen Cave (optional tour).
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-floored bridge across a canyon near Zhangjiajie, offered as an optional tour.
